description: Validerer product_audit + trigger efter prisændring på Espresso.

assertions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'product_audit'

SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM pg_trigger t WHERE t.tgrelid = 'public.products'::regclass AND t.tgname = 'trg_product_price' AND t.tgfoid = to_regprocedure('public.log_product_price_change()') AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgtype = 17 AND t.tgenabled IN ('O','A')
assertions.message: En aktiv AFTER UPDATE-rækketrigger på products bruger log_product_price_change

assertions.sql: SELECT price FROM products WHERE name = 'Espresso'
SELECT old_price, new_price FROM product_audit a JOIN products p ON p.id = a.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Espresso' ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1
